Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    varPerfilUser = "Base",
    Sort(
        Filter(
            '7.4-tbl_InspPista',
            StartsWith(
                Aeroporto,
                varAeroUser
            ) And Criado < DateValue("25/11/2023")
        ),
        Criado,
        SortOrder.Descending
    ),
    Sort(
        Filter(
            '7.4-tbl_InspPista',
            Criado < DateValue("25/11/2023")
        ),
        Criado,
        SortOrder.Descending
    )
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString: If(Self.Layout = Layout.Horizontal, Min(280, Self.Width - 60), Min(280, Self.Height - 60))

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    LookUp(
        '7.4.1-tbl_InspPistaItens',
        IdInsp = ThisItem.ID And Status = "Não conforme",
        ID
    ) > 0,
    "🔍"
)

Filter(
    '7.4.1-tbl_InspPistaItens',
    IdInsp = Gallery7.Selected.ID And Status = "Não conforme"
)
